sources.snippet: Precise wheat head detection is essential for plant counting and yield estimation in precision agriculture. To tackle the difficulties arising from densely packed wheat heads with diverse scales and intricate occlusions in real-world field conditions, this research introduces YOLO v11n-GRN, an improved wheat head detection model founded on the streamlined YOLO v11n framework.
